name: Silas Kincaid
source_profile:
Silas Kincaid (LN) — Founder and Chief Superintendent

Silas is a former royal provost officer who established the agency after growing frustrated with the corruption and incompetence of local authorities. Stern, calculating, and exceptionally disciplined, he prides himself on the Greycoats' professionalism and their ability to accomplish tasks beyond the means of ordinary lawmen. Kincaid insists that the agency serves the law
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 42 (source excerpt; may be partial)
